reviews.title: Extremely Upset With PawChamp’s Subscription Practices
reviews.text:
I am incredibly disappointed with PawChamp and the way its subscription is handled.

I signed up for a trial toward the end of March and apparently did not successfully cancel it. Beginning shortly afterward, I was charged **$38.99 PER MONTH** without realizing these charges were continuing.

What makes this even more frustrating is that when I finally went through the cancellation process, PawChamp suddenly offered me a **$29.99 LIFETIME subscription**.

How does it make any sense to charge an existing customer **$38.99 every single month**, yet offer lifetime access for less than the cost of ONE MONTH when they try to cancel? That pricing structure felt absolutely outrageous and, frankly, like highway robbery.

There were also extraordinary circumstances involved. My husband died unexpectedly in a car accident on April 1, shortly after I had signed up for the trial. Needless to say, managing an app subscription was nowhere near the top of my mind during the months following his death. I explained the situation to PawChamp and told them that I genuinely believed I had canceled the trial, but they **refused to refund any of the money I had been charged**.

I understand that technically a subscription may renew if it isn't canceled correctly. What I find unacceptable is the complete lack of compassion or reasonable customer service after I explained what had happened — especially while the company was simultaneously offering me lifetime access for **$29.99 after charging me $3

reviews.title: Complete scam
reviews.text: PawChamp is a complete scam, and I strongly recommend avoiding it. I was charged multiple times without authorization after what I believed was a one-time purchase. At no point during checkout was it clearly disclosed that I was signing up for a recurring subscription. This is misleading at best and deceptive at worst. When I reached out to their support team, I explained: “I am contacting you regarding multiple charges on my account that I did not authorize. At the time of purchase, there was no clear indication that I was enrolling in a recurring subscription. I understood this to be a one-time payment.” Their response pointed me to their so-called “Money-Back Guarantee,” which is frankly absurd. To even qualify for a refund, they require you to: Have purchased directly through their website Submit a request within 30 days Follow their training plan for at least 7 consecutive days And somehow prove you’ve seen “no meaningful progress” with your dog This is not a real refund policy—it’s a wall of conditions designed to prevent refunds. Between the hidden subscription, unauthorized charges, and unreasonable refund requirements, this company operates in a way that feels intentionally deceptive. Stay far away..

I saw this app advertised and thought ok a printable check list of things I can do that would be extra and hopefully work out better. Yeah - no. 
There is no list. This is app is full of very generic advice. There is nothing behind the paywall that is worth having. If you, as the owner, have done your due diligence from the moment you got your dog this app will not provide anything new or unlock anything for you. 

Your local PetCo / PetSmart offers better in person affordable training.

reviews.title: Misleading pricing and no refund
reviews.text:
I downloaded Paw Champ because it was advertised as a one-time $15 payment with no subscription. At no point did I knowingly agree to a $38/month charge. Later, I discovered I was being billed $38 monthly.

I contacted customer support immediately and explained that:
	•	I only wanted to try the app
	•	It did not work for my dog
	•	I stopped using the app
	•	I would never knowingly sign up for a $38/month subscription

Despite this, support refused to issue a refund, hiding behind their “refund policy.” If the pricing had been clear and transparent from the start, I would never have downloaded the app.

What makes this worse is that they can clearly see in their logs that I barely used the app. Still, they insisted there was “nothing they could do.”

This feels misleading at best and predatory at worst. Charging people for a high monthly subscription they didn’t clearly agree to and then refusing refunds is not acceptable.

Do not download this app unless you are 100% certain about the pricing. Customer service was unhelpful, dismissive, and offered no resolution.

Because of how they handled it, I’m now going to download a different dog training app because now I’m ready to use it and can afford it.

Then support offers you 50% off your next month if you choose not to cancel the subscription for the app that doesn’t work. No stars! Since they will say to contact support, I have, they refused to give me a refund until I use the app that doesn’t work for 7 consecutive days and provide proof of using it, which none of this can be done because the app doesn’t work, which makes this a SCAM!

Update, after about 10 messages I finally got it through to them that the app doesn’t work and that I needed my money back, granted I had already provided video that it doesn’t work and they still offered me a deeper 75% discount for next month, but for the same app that doesn’t work. reviews.title: Terrible service
reviews.text:
I bought what was advertised as a one-off training course from PawChamp in October, but I later discovered I was billed twice for a membership I never knowingly signed up for. After checking online, I saw many others reporting the same issue.
The course content itself wasn’t great — very basic and not worth the cost. I’ve now requested a refund for the last two months and asked for the subscription to be cancelled.
Overall, disappointing experience.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I thought I canceled the service in June, after realizing that it wouldn’t work for us. I was charged in December (their emails go to my junk folder I found out when I had to reset my password after being charged.)  I requested a refund because I’m sure it’s clear to them that the app has not been accessed and was denied. Instead I was offered additional incentives to stay despite not having a need for the service any longer. Disappointing that their customer service team isn’t the least bit understanding or willing to offer credits when there is no longer a need. I’ve canceled and will find alternative options should we have a need in the future.

reviews.title: AI Heavy Lessons & Inflexible Customer Service
reviews.text: This app strikes me as strange with all of the clearly AI-generated images (and possibly the text) in the lessons. The lessons are extremely simplistic without much detail, and give generic information. I did not try to talk with any trainers, so I am unsure how that part of the app is. I did not want my subscription renewed after the trial date, and in my timezone it was still the previous day. However, I was charged anyway and immediately contacted customer service within one minute of the charge saying it was a mistake and asked to be refunded for the charge. They refused, saying their 'hands were tied' and that a refund would be impossible... even though it was only a minute after the charge and I am in a different timezone. I wouldn't use this app, it just screams 'AI slop' at almost every turn. Maybe contacting the trainers is better, but I did not access that part of the app because I just wanted in depth and detailed written lessons. What I got was surface level, possibly AI-written lessons with AI images (however there are some real videos in some). I can't even tell if the customer service emails were real or AI, as the response speed and content within seemed to tell me they were auto-generated. I suspect they aren't real either.
